_note: Curated offline heuristic database for demo/offline use. It is NOT exhaustive. Enable APKPT_SCA_ONLINE=1 to enrich results with the public OSV.dev API, and replace this file with a maintained feed for production use.

vulnerabilities.title: Outdated OkHttp version with known TLS/HTTP handling issues
vulnerabilities.description: OkHttp versions before 3.12.0 are out of maintenance and are affected by multiple historical defects in TLS and HTTP/2 handling.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to a currently maintained OkHttp 4.x release.

vulnerabilities.title: jsoup denial of service / incomplete parsing
vulnerabilities.description: jsoup versions before 1.14.2 are vulnerable to a denial-of-service condition when parsing specially crafted input.

vulnerabilities.title: Guava temporary directory permissions
vulnerabilities.description: Guava versions before 30.0.0 create temporary directories with overly permissive permissions, allowing local information disclosure.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade Guava to 30.0.0 or later and avoid Files.createTempDir().

vulnerabilities.title: Log4Shell - remote code execution via JNDI lookups
vulnerabilities.description: Log4j 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1 allows remote code execution when attacker-controlled data is logged. Android usage is less common but must be ruled out.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to Log4j 2.15.0+ (prefer 2.17.1+) or remove the dependency.

vulnerabilities.title: Jackson-databind deserialization gadget chain
vulnerabilities.description: Jackson-databind before 2.9.10 is affected by a deserialization flaw that can lead to information disclosure or code execution when polymorphic handling is enabled.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to a maintained 2.x release and disable default typing.

vulnerabilities.title: Commons IO path traversal
vulnerabilities.description: Commons IO before 2.7.0 contains a path-traversal flaw in FilenameUtils.normalize on Windows.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade Commons IO to 2.7.0 or later.

vulnerabilities.title: Outdated Bouncy Castle / Spongy Castle provider
vulnerabilities.description: Old Bouncy Castle and Spongy Castle releases contain historical cryptographic weaknesses and are no longer maintained.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Upgrade to a maintained Bouncy Castle release (1.68+ / 2.x).

vulnerabilities.title: libwebp heap buffer overflow (lossless WebP decoding)
vulnerabilities.description: A heap overflow in libwebp can be triggered by a crafted WebP image and has been exploited in the wild.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Update the bundled libwebp to 1.3.2+ or rely on an updated system WebView/ImageDecoder.
